process_issues.description: The PR modifies .claude/skills/pr-ci-review/SKILL.md, but .claude-pr/skills/pr-ci-review/ was missing from the checkout, so the PR's own copy of the config file was not preserved. The docs reviewer worked from `gh pr diff 340` and the in-tree working copy, which showed the file as modified, so its stale-shape grep ran against that copy and not a preserved PR copy.

Skipped correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety and spec. The diff is a two-line prose edit to a skill file: no code logic, no trust boundary, no new construct, no workflow change, and no closing keyword or linked issue (the PR says 'Follow-up to #335', which closes nothing). The docs reviewer checked the new prose's claims against priorVerdictSchema and prior-record.utils.ts.
